patches.name: NoMapLine.def
new: /-- Item 435: the negative arm of the map frames face — no mapping value line is open at the
stack top: the top is the sentinel or a sequence level. -/
def NoMapLine (sc : ScannerState) : Prop :=
sc.currentIndent < 0 ∨ ∃ e, sc.indents.back? = some e ∧ e.isSequence = true
